verdict.rationale: Convertio's API pricing page explicitly addresses all three dimensions, listing 'Unlimited*' file size, 'Unlimited' maximum conversion time per file and 'Unlimited' concurrent conversions. The web converter documents a concrete 1 GB maximum file size. However, the asterisk on 'Unlimited' is never explained, per-tier limits for the free or other API plans are not shown, and the developer API docs themselves do not state limits, so a developer cannot fully size jobs from the evidence. Missing for 10: explanation of the 'Unlimited*' caveat, per-plan file-size/duration/concurrency limits in the API developer docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, file-size, duration, and concurrency limits are documented, so I can size jobs before hitting a wall

citations.quote: Unlimited* file size Unlimited maximum conversion time per file Unlimited concurrent conversions
